content.title: BJP appoints Yuzvendra Chahal as special invitee to OBC Morcha executive committee
content.caption: Indian cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal has been appointed as a Special Invitee to the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) National Other Backwards Classes (OBC) Morcha executive committee.

slides.heading: BJP appoints Yuzvendra Chahal as special invitee to OBC Morcha
slides.text: Indian cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal has been appointed as a Special Invitee to the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) National Other Backwards Classes (OBC) Morcha executive committee.

slides.heading: Relevant context
slides.text: The appointment is part of the BJP's fresh appointments for its OBC Morcha with immediate effect.

slides.heading: Important details
slides.text: The appointment includes seven national vice presidents, three national general secretaries, and seven national secretaries.
